title: Villa, Sheikh Zayed (east half of the twin: basement + ground floor)

facts.household: Two adults and three children; no staff; no gender separation of reception; no prayer room.
facts.privacy: The parents' suite must be private (reached without crossing living, dining or kitchen, and no other room reached through it). Children's rooms need not be.
facts.ageing: Ageing in place is a preference: M4(2) bathroom/WC sizes are the target; a shortfall is a warning, not a failure.
facts.outdoors: Garden, shaded terrace and BBQ in our sunken yard (-1.80). No pool, no parking in scope.
facts.kitchen: Open kitchen plus a separate dirty kitchen; built-in panel-ready appliances.
facts.styles: Warm contemporary, Japandi, Scandinavian, warm transitional.
facts.review: Plan PDFs first, then 3D, then renders.
